violated_contract: v3 owns the boundaries, merges and claims of v3_derived and recording rows; a legacy smart-merge absorb, whose redirect keeps v3_derived and transfers no claims, never takes a v3-owned row as its donor, so the v3 processing drain never sees ConversationAbsorbed.
canonical_prevention: The pre-notes merge boundary (merge_before_processing.before_notes) returns before any merge read for a conversation whose v3_derived or recording marker is True, behind the default-on kill switch CONVERSATION_MERGE_BEFORE_PROCESSING_V3_EXCLUSION; a boundary test pins that the merge worker is never loaded for either marker and that the kill switch restores the absorb.
